observations: The page number «22» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature.

L01-L05 end chapter 28a (p. 21, JP2 0053, L28-L30): the shadow s squared and 144 added; the side of the square, «elgidher» (al-jidhr, the root), is the hypotenuse, «diametros»; the shadow times sixty divided by it is a sine, whose arc subtracted from ninety is the altitude. Checked: s·60/√(s²+144) = 60 cos h for the shadow s = 12 cot h of a gnomon of twelve digits, whose arc is 90° − h; ninety less it is the altitude h.

L06-L15: chapter 28b, the reversed shadow, «umbra elmankuz» (al-ẓill al-mankūs), from the altitude: the sine of the altitude («elgeib primum») times twelve, divided by the sine of its complement («elgeib secundum»), gives the reversed shadow in digits and minutes. Checked: 12 sin h / cos h = 12 tan h, the shadow of a gnomon of twelve digits set at right angles to a wall. In the left margin beside L07 «O 133r»; beside the heading of chapter 29 (L16) «C 76r, O 133v».

L16-L24: chapter 29: «elbuht» (al-buht), which the text renders «stupor», is the arc that a planet travels in a given time, found as the difference of its places on two successive days, or for an hour or a moment. L25-L27: chapter 30, the size of the sun's disc, continued on p. 23. «stupor» is in italics in L18 and in roman type in L23 and L27.

L12: «dakaikas», with k for the c of «dakaicas» elsewhere in the text; transcribed as printed. N04: «{sup:11})intrabitur]», without a space after the bracket of the note number; the square bracket after «intrabitur» is printed with its upper part missing. N04: a small dark speck before the O after «item]», not transcribed.
The colons and semicolons of the text stand after the thin space of the edition (10-12 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the notes added within the series are numbered after the note that they follow, «quaeris{sup:5a})» after note 5; the note on «duodenarium» follows note 11 and the apparatus numbers it 11a (N04, «{sup:11a}) duodenarium] O, XII C.»); the text prints 10a
the second u of «secundum» is printed upside down, as an n
the lemma repeats the text of L04, «quod quaeris»; the u of «quaeris» is printed upside down, as an n

the reading of O in note 25: «sic igitur differentia eorum considerata», the difference of them (the two places) being considered, as the text has «differentiaque locorum illorum considerata» (L21); «corum» is no Latin word, probably c for e. It may report the spelling of O itself
